notes: Penn State states it has no university-wide GenAI rule (per search summaries of the integrity site); the policy is course-level, with unauthorized tools covered by the academic integrity policy. The recommended syllabus statements live on integrity.psu.edu ('Academic Integrity and Artificial Intelligence', Faculty Resources) but the page could not be fetched (academicintegrity.psu.edu/courses/.../artificial-intelligence is an orientation shell without AI text, v2-pennstate-ai.txt; integrity.psu.edu path returned 526 chars). Not collected: Smeal eLDIG pages (business school, not computing), libraries Generative AI guide (library guide; its academic integrity paragraph quotes the student orientation), ai.psu.edu education/resource-library pages (navigation). No CSE or EECS department-level AI policy found. Course syllabi deferred.
